originals.ko: 우리 그녀에게 그 책 주러 집에 갈까?
originals.why: Welsh uses 'awn ni' (shall we go, from mynd), not the LEGO 'gawn ni' (may we have, from cael). This row was matched on the substring and does not practise this LEGO.

originals.ko: 우리 지금 학교에 갈까?
originals.why: 'awn ni' = shall we go, not 'gawn ni' = may we have; the LEGO is absent.
